rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unstable public situation or a serious personal-life crisis.

example.english: This financial crisis has left many people unemployed.
example.traditional: 呢場金融危機搞到好多人失業。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 gam1 jung4 ngai4 gei1 gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 sat1 jip6

rows.note: Use this for a decisive change or turning point rather than an unstable situation itself.

example.english: That crisis became a turning point in his life.
example.traditional: 嗰場危機成為佢人生嘅轉捩點。
example.jyutping: go2 coeng4 ngai4 gei1 sing4 wai4 keoi5 jan4 saang1 ge3 zyun2 lit6 dim2
